bridgewright.type.flat.desc: A straight deck between the two points. Rises over water to leave room for boats.
bridgewright.type.arch.desc: The deck curves up to a high point in the middle.
bridgewright.type.stone_arch.desc: An arch with a solid curved underside. Needs full blocks matching your slabs (stone bricks for stone brick slabs, planks for wooden slabs).
bridgewright.type.trestle.desc: Fence legs every 4 blocks down to the ground or riverbed. Needs fences.
bridgewright.type.suspension.desc: Fence towers at each end with cables sagging between them. Needs fences and width 3 or more.
screen.bridgewright.title: Bridge Wand
screen.bridgewright.clearance_hint: Over water, the bridge is raised to leave %s blocks of air underneath. Trestles keep a channel clear of legs.
tooltip.bridgewright.help1: Use on a block: mark start, then end
tooltip.bridgewright.help2: Use in the air: build (sneak: settings)
tooltip.bridgewright.help3: Sneak + use on a block: clear points
message.bridgewright.pos_b: End set at %s. %s, %s blocks long: about %s. Use in the air to build.
message.bridgewright.same_spot: The end must be away from the start
message.bridgewright.need_points: Mark both ends first by using the wand on blocks
message.bridgewright.wrong_dimension: The bridge points are in another dimension
message.bridgewright.too_long: Bridge is %s blocks long; the limit is %s
message.bridgewright.suspension_width: Suspension bridges need width 3 or more
message.bridgewright.no_slabs: You need slabs in your inventory
message.bridgewright.needs_fences: A %s bridge needs fences in your inventory
message.bridgewright.no_full_block: No full block found to match %s
message.bridgewright.nothing: Nothing to build: the way is already blocked or protected
message.bridgewright.built_no_rails: Built %s bridge: %s blocks placed (no fences in your inventory, so no railings)
message.bridgewright.steep: This bridge climbs more than half a block per block, so parts of it can't be walked up.
message.bridgewright.clearance_short: The bridge couldn't be raised enough for boats everywhere: the banks are too close to the water for the ramps.
